column1: # Committed figures that redraw_figures.sh redraws at their committed size from a kit run's handoff RDS,

# Pixel sizes are those of the files in episodes/fig/ (res 300). before: chunks of the same episode run first,
# for figures that need objects the handoff RDS does not hold (- for none). Added 2026-10-22.
